name: SeasonsRewardsU32List
summary: One u32 member body of the SeasonsRewardsTrackedStat replicated state: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u32. The client's own container readers 0x14377a160 and 0x142d98f60 are the sibling non-zero branches; every recorded body takes the zero-count branch (0x14293da60 and 0x142d99270).
purpose: Name the u32 member layout that the two-level presence mask selects (group 0 members 1 and 4 of codec.seasons-rewards-tracked-stat-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of copying the container's layout.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint delta count 0x14377a160 reads before it branches. It is 0 in both measured bodies, which select the zero branch (0x14293da60 for groupList, 0x142d99270 for groupStatValue); the non-zero masked-map branch has no instance, so the card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero branch: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. Both measured bodies carry 01 08 (8).

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u32, read by FUN_14087a3c0. groupList carries 2 elements (572611289, 2365596905), groupStatValue 51 (all zero). Meaning not established.

evidence.ref: Member readers 0x14377a160 / 0x142d98f60 and their zero branches 0x14293da60 / 0x142d99270 (build 30fe6461).
